title: De imputatione primi peccati Adami (Cap. I-IV tip: probable + necessary args + Decree exposition)
author: Josué de la Place (Placeus)
edition: De imputatione primi peccati Adami (Salmurii: Apud Ioannem Lesnerium, 1661). IA deimputationepri00lapl. Densify: Caput Primum + Caput II probable I-VII + Caput III necessaria + Caput IV tip through Garissoles's admission of the mediate/immediate distinction (not whole Disputatio; remainder of Cap. IV and Cap. V+ remain).
blurb: Josue de la Place (Placeus) — Capita I-IV tip of De imputatione primi peccati Adami from the 1661 Saumur Latin: Charenton framing, seven probable arguments, necessary arguments, and Placeus's mediate-imputation exposition. Honest partial; remainder of Cap. IV and later Capita of the Disputatio remain.
era_note: Placeus wrote in the mid-seventeenth century as Reformed theology professor at the Academy of Saumur. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed / Saumur retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1661 Saumur Latin is public domain. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1661 Saumur Latin of Capita I-IV tip, reconstructed from IA PDF page images with pdftotext and tesseract as check (visual page check for Cap. III-IV). No modern English was copied. Remainder of Cap. IV and Cap. V+ remain.
